name: Xiaomi open-sources the MiMo-V2.6 RL environments on Hugging Face
title: Xiaomi open-sources the MiMo-V2.6 RL environments on Hugging Face
summary: Xiaomi published the reinforcement-learning environments used to train MiMo-V2.6 as an Apache 2.0 dataset: thousands of tasks across coding and SWE, cybersecurity and tool use, with rule-based verifiers and Docker images, usable directly for agent RL runs.
